text:
Alex: Heads up — ops asked for clearer notifications when an automatic fallback triggers during rollouts. They keep seeing quiet handoffs and missacting.
Maria: Noted. Are we talking console badges + emails, or in-product banners for affected routes?
Sam: Email + console breadcrumb is ideal. Ops wants an immediate short pulse in Slack as well. :bell: 
Jin: For the UX side, we need to avoid noise. Maybe combine threshold + sticky reason. eg "AUTO-FALLBACK: latency > 95th pct, route=chat-rl, model=falcon-40b"
Anya: Can we include a link to the playback + audit trace in the notification? one-click to open trace would speed triage.
deploy-bot: deploy: rollout v3.4 -> risk-mode=AUTO-FALLBACK triggered on 3 hosts
Alex: @Maria good to show trace link. Also need an operator-visible TTL for the fallback (e.g. 10m) and a one-click rollback or pin primary model.
Maria: UI idea: toast + compact drawer. Drawer shows triggers (error, latency, quota), sample requests, and quick actions: [Pin primary], [Extend TTL], [Acknowledge]
Sam: UX nit — keep the default action as Acknowledge, not Pin. Pin should require 2-step confirmation for safety.
Jin: Backend needs to emit structured telemetry for these events: event_type, trigger_reason, affected_routes, policy_id, rollout_id, sample_request_id, playbook_link.
Anya: If telemetry includes sample_request_id we can surface deterministic replay in the console. Good.
Alex: Also ops wants SLA-impact estimate in the message: % of traffic affected, estimated cost delta.
Maria: We can show quick metrics snapshot (qps, error-rate, p95 latency) alongside the notification. Pull from last 5m window.
Sam: Question: do we add an opt-in noise filter? Some customers will see lots of small fallbacks; we should allow rollouts teams to mute low-severity ones.
Jin: Agreed. Policy model should have severity tags and an optional sampling window. e.g. severity=LOW -> only surface if sustained for > 2m or affects > 5% traffic.
Anya: What about auditability? All operator actions must be logged with who/when/why. We need immutable event IDs to replay.
deploy-bot: audit: event 0x9f2c logged for rollout 12345 by policy auto-fallback
Alex: Action items: 1) define telemetry schema (Jin) 2) console drawer mockups (Maria) 3) slack/email formatting + rate limit (Sam) 4) audit event semantics + immutable IDs (Anya)
Sam: I'll prototype the Slack format: short header, reason, % traffic, link to trace, and a suppress button.
Maria: Will mock drawer and the confirmation flow for Pin/Extend TTL. Also will add "Why did this happen?" expandable text.
Jin: I'll draft a JSON schema for the telemetry and example payloads. Will include fields for quantized metrics and sample request.
Anya: I'll write the audit spec and retention policy for ops review.
Alex: Thanks. Let's sync tomorrow 11am PST. If anyone hits major blockers before then drop quick notes here. :thumbsup:
